status: PROPOSED by openspec/changes/touch-controls (design 3 and 4), approved on the owner's sight of docs/mockups/touch-controls.html (2026-10-13: 'Looks good'). Sizes are px of a reference frame screen_ref_px high (the 1080 reference pixels of data/ui/reference.json, which a phone held sideways shows 390 CSS px high) and scale with that frame, as every screen does (openspec/changes/browser-page-fit design 5); times in seconds.

stick._note: The move stick appears where the left thumb lands, inside the zone: the left zone_w of the screen, below its top zone_top.

console._note: Seated: a tap presses the nearest control within reach_px of the finger (hit areas of at least 44 px); held long_press_s within still_px, it shows the control's tip and presses nothing.
